column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS records to OSCAL

# mapping_set_description: Class-level mappings between the records of an ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS and the classes of the Open Security Controls Assessment Language (OSCAL) 1.2.3 that lmodel/oscal models. Each row maps a class of this schema to a class of the released lmodel/oscal v0.1.2 schema asset, which tests/neighbours/ holds, named by the IRI the released copy gives it. The rows were first drafted by a language model and then each was checked against both classes' descriptions; a row whose object no released copy holds, or whose meaning did not hold, was dropped. They await review by a person.

column10: Both hold the security records of their scope: an organization's ISMS, or one system's security plan
The organization's control is one of its own set of controls; an OSCAL control is an entry of a control catalog
Both state for a set of controls whether and how each is in place; the Statement of Applicability also records excluded Annex A controls
Both state for one control whether and how it is in place
Both plan actions against risks; a POA&M also tracks deviations and their disposition
Both record one remedial action and its status
An ISMS audit is planned and carried out as an OSCAL assessment is
An audit programme plans the audits an assessment plan would describe one by one
Both define a function with responsibilities, which people or parties are assigned
An OSCAL party is an organization or a person, so it is broader than the organization that runs the ISMS
An inventory item of a system is one kind of asset in the ISMS's inventory
